column1: #  - function f, local function f and `local f = function` (both at any depth), and a top-level `f = function` / `M.f = function` are functions;
#  - function M.f and function M.a.f are functions named f; function M:m is a method named m;
#  - a function-valued field of a table that is assigned or returned (up to 3 levels of nesting; the key may be a name or a string) is a function; a table passed as a call argument declares nothing;
#  - a top-level local or global initialised with a table constructor is a variable (the module or class object);
#  - other locals, numbers, strings, non-function fields and anonymous functions are not definitions.
